name: Wake County Government
source_citation: Wake County Strategic Plan & FY 2025-2029 Capital Improvement Program
mission: Wake County will be a thriving community of opportunity where all residents enjoy healthy lives, economic prosperity, excellent public education, and safe, vibrant neighborhoods.
funder_affinities: Department of Housing and Urban Development
Department of Health and Human Services

goals.title: Affordable Housing, Homelessness Prevention, and Community Development
goals.citation: Wake County Affordable Housing Plan, Priority 1, pp. 8-14
goals.description: Expand permanently affordable housing units, support rapid re-housing for vulnerable families, and upgrade neighborhood infrastructure across growing suburban and urban corridors.
objectives: Construct and preserve multi-family affordable rental units near transit corridors
Expand emergency shelter capacity and rapid re-housing vouchers
Implement neighborhood revitalization and community revitalization block grants

goals.title: Public Health, Behavioral Health, and Emergency Medical Services
goals.citation: Wake County Community Health Needs Assessment, Chapter 3
goals.description: Strengthen community-based mental health crisis response, reduce substance use overdose fatalities, and modernize county public health clinics and EMS response times.
objectives: Deploy mobile crisis intervention units and diversion from hospital emergency rooms
Expand harm reduction, naloxone distribution, and opioid settlement programming
Modernize EMS fleet, pediatric paramedic equipment, and 911 dispatch interoperability

goals.title: County Water Quality, Parks, Greenways, and Open Space Preservation
goals.citation: Wake County Open Space Master Plan & Watershed Protection Guidelines
goals.description: Protect Falls Lake and Jordan Lake watershed quality, expand regional multi-use greenways, and preserve open agricultural and forest conservation land against rapid suburban sprawl.
objectives: Acquire conservation easements along Neuse River and Swift Creek watersheds
Complete missing links in the East Coast Greenway and county park network
Mitigate stormwater runoff in rapidly developing unincorporated county jurisdictions

goals.title: Public Safety, Criminal Justice Diversion, and Emergency Preparedness
goals.citation: Wake County Public Safety Master Plan & Hazard Mitigation Plan
goals.description: Strengthen county sheriff and detention services, advance pre-trial diversion, and harden emergency operations centers against severe weather and cyber incidents.
objectives: Expand juvenile justice diversion and adult re-entry supportive services
Harden county emergency management facilities against Category 3 hurricane impacts
Upgrade public safety radio networks (VIPER) and first responder communications
